actions.READ: advance.15, pay read fee, receive noisy target-bit and outage indicator
actions.RESET: preserve unknown bit, reset physical X0, advance.25, pay reset fee, receive outage indicator

bootstrap.scope: Conditional on these three fitted models and this registered context domain; six context clusters give limited population evidence
bootstrap.unit: heldout context, with equal cue/profile/episode and three independently fitted model averages

light_controller: Rolling one-action lookahead, all5 actions considered, same3-action execution horizon
observations: Raw cue, public context, known prices/durations, own actions, noisy READ bits, and interval outage bit. Exact event counts and hidden states appear only in terminal settlement/audit records, never planner features.
predecessor: experiments/hcsn_joint_dynamics_20261101/REPORT_ZH.md: prior scalar task stays negative; this is a redesigned finite mechanism study

primary.adoption: Original learned-network and real AV gates remain open regardless of this finite witness
primary.analytic_increment: D-B complete actual utility, positive for each fit and context-bootstrap lower bound>0
primary.distribution_mechanism: D minus joint-train/factorized-execution on association cues2/3, positive for each fit and context-bootstrap lower bound>0 plus actual action differences

prior_fit: Full joint empirical MLE versus independently fitted product-marginal MLE from identical stratified samples; not neural network retraining
reporting: All5 main2x2 contrasts; all4 training/execution cells, mean-projection intervention, first actions and complete action counts. Zero-width same-law intervals do not establish population certainty.
reward: terminal bit correctness minus actual READ/RESET fees, elapsed-time fee and actual repeated-outage fee
test_domain: New independent context features from[-1,1]^2 under same fixed rate-function family; training context features from[-.8,.8]^2; not an unknown generator family
training: Shared fully observed physical transition counts/exposures and state-labelled READ calibration; balanced cue-state-bit identification. Both full-law cores and both controllers receive identical fitted models, never trueQ or sampled hidden test X,Y.
value_controller: Exact finite remaining-horizon belief DP under fitted model; 1e-10 action tie tolerance and14decimal belief memoization
